findings.issue: Baghead is sniffing the moonshine the player just handed him, and Moonshine is frozen as العَرَق — masculine. رائحتها attaches the smell to a feminine referent that has not been named.

Dialogue-choice options carry a full stop that the English does not have, and the frozen UI pair is نعم / لا with no punctuation. Both options in this scene: D1B7E8FF... ('No' -> لا.) and F3CFF79E... ('Yes' -> نعم.).

findings.source_en: A real one. Nice and quiet.
findings.issue: هذه المرة ('this time') has no basis in the English and implies a previous attempt that the line does not refer to.
